description: This file contains inline functions for managing and querying MPU (Memory Protection Unit) regions on ARM Cortex-A processors, including functions to get/set region attributes, base address, size, and check if a buffer is within a region.

methods.name: get_num_regions
methods.description: Returns the number of supported MPU regions by reading the MPU type register.

methods.name: get_region_attributes
methods.description: Retrieves the current attributes of an MPU region.

methods.name: get_region_base_address
methods.description: Gets the base address of an MPU region.

methods.name: get_region_size
methods.description: Gets the size of an MPU region.

methods.name: set_region_attributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes for an MPU region.

methods.name: set_region_base_address
methods.description: Sets the base address for an MPU region.

methods.name: set_region_number
methods.description: Selects the current MPU region by index.

methods.name: mpu_region_get_base
methods.description: Returns the base address of a specific MPU region.

methods.name: mpu_rasr_size_to_size
methods.description: Converts the SIZE field value of MPU_RASR to the size in bytes.

methods.name: set_region_size
methods.description: Sets the size of an MPU region.

methods.name: ARM_MPU_ClrRegion
methods.description: Clears (disables) an MPU region by setting its size to zero.

methods.name: is_enabled_region
methods.description: Checks if a specific MPU region is enabled.

methods.name: get_region_ap
methods.description: Returns the access permissions of a specific MPU region.

methods.name: is_in_region
methods.description: Checks if a given buffer (start address and size) is within a specified MPU region.

methods.name: mpu_region_get_size
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of a specific MPU region.
